primary_route: Progress curves, loading/product-addback/stability and substrate-by-inhibitor fits.

checks.reason: No prospective no-enzyme/no-substrate background and known-response/procedural controls with their roles; changing enzyme or adding product does not define those controls.
No pre-execution consultation and transfer-check of prior Methods or validated protocols.
No detector reference calibration with acceptance limits and failed-calibration action; progress-curve shape is not a product-recovery calibration.
Rate units and a depletion bound are given, but no baseline-corrected measurement specification with weak/saturated/missing-signal rules.
No operational independent product/readout validation; repeated time points and enzyme titration retain the original detector artifact.
Explicit linearity/depletion and failed-regime alternatives determine whether the predicted initial rate can be used.

checks.quote: an uncompetitive inhibitor cutting Vmax to ~52 nmol/min
checks.reason: Four independent errors: the uncompetitive numerical example with proportional Km reduction gives about 24.1, not the competitive example 12.86 nmol/min; the Morrison tight-binding inhibitor equation is prescribed for substrate sequestration without an inhibitor; Michaelis-Menten behavior does not require a single active site; fixed nonsaturating cosubstrate conditions can give apparent hyperbolic parameters and need not invalidate the form.
